device: dedicated Android16 API36 ARM64 emulator-5584; not target tablet

instrumentation.note: ThumbnailNavigationTest needs a 400+ page lecture fixture; this run used a generated 420-page synthetic PDF pushed to the debug app through run-as. The fixture is not committed and contains no user content.

packing.verifiedMarker: .verified manifest hash skips re-hashing ~310 MB on later starts

apk.transport: local loopback HTTP only; never uploaded

retrieval.queryParity: 821,177 candidate keys and 84 queries compared with schema4: no set or order differences

translation.postprocess: CJK punctuation/spacing/terminal period; digits and Latin words untouched
translation.decision: no stable chrF gain (bootstrap intervals include 0) and beam costs 3.6x; ship post-processing only

updateChannel: unchanged; latest public release remains v1.2.0 (https://github.com/dpan538/Annota/releases/tag/v1.2.0)
knownLimitations: Reverse zh-en entries are machine-merged equivalents, not individually proofread; at most four English equivalents per Chinese word.
Packing every database adds one decompression pass on the first launch after install/update (measured ~1.9 s first launch vs ~1.0 s later starts on the emulator).
Translation improvements are output-format robustness and completeness gates, not semantic accuracy; decoder errors remain.
Emulator results do not replace Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max device acceptance.
